title: Greed and avarice
def: The Quran condemns miserliness and hoarding, and promises success to those saved from the greed of their own souls.
what: “Those who are stingy with what God has given them of His bounty should not think it good for them; it will be a burden on their necks on the Day of Resurrection” (3:180). Of those who hoard gold and silver and do not spend it in God’s way, the Quran promises a painful punishment (9:34). “Whoever is saved from the greed of his own soul, those are the successful” (59:9).
